text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [PAGER] CRITICAL - Private cluster autoscaler failing to provision GPU nodes for customer BlueBank (cluster: bluebank-prod-vpc) — queue growth > 1200, 95th token latency > 7s. Paging on-call now.
alex.sre: Ack, on call. Looking into autoscaler logs and node bootstrap traces. ETA 2m.
jess.sre: I see repeated failures in node boot: kubelet never becomes Ready, image pull fails with 403 from internal registry. Error: "image signature verification rejected". This started ~10:42 UTC
dan.runtime: Autoscaler tried to spin up 12 nodes but they got stuck in ProvisioningPending due to instance-init failing. Also saw rate-limited API errors from customer's private CA during attestation.
priya.pm: Customer impact: BlueBank production workloads are getting 500s on inference paths when they hit queued requests. They've reported some user-facing timeouts. Need a mitigation plan and customer comms.
marco.custsuccess: I've reached out to BlueBank to notify them we're on it. They confirmed they recently changed their image signing policy and rotated KMS keys yesterday.
eng-platform: Noted. Could be the new signing policy + our bootstrap flow using old key thumbprint.
alex.sre: Quick mitigation idea: temporarily route traffic for lowest-SLO customers to hosted fallback models to reduce pressure on private cluster. Can we flip routing rule for bluebank to fallback tier? :thinking:
jess.sre: Yes, we can set a policy to route 10%/50%/100% gradually. But for production impact we should start at 30% immediately while we fix bootstrap.
dan.runtime: I can push a canary routing policy: set route route_id=bluebank-infer fallback_model=redwood-small-128q enable_percent=30. Command:
```
redwoodctl routes update --customer bluebank --route infer --fallback-model redwood-small-128q --spill-percent 30
```
alex.sre: Do it. That should shave off load. Also opening a config to increase autoscaler maxNodes temporarily (current limit 20) to 40 so it can attempt more parallel boot attempts once bootstrap fixed.
eng-platform: Hold on increasing limit until we confirm quota availability in the customer's VPC. Might hit provider quota errors. I'll check.
jess.sre: Meanwhile, temp manual workaround: we can allow a manual override of the customer's admission controller check that rejects images signed with the new key. We need BlueBank's authorization to bypass policy - Marco can confirm.
marco.custsuccess: BlueBank ops has authorized a temporary override for immediate remediation. They want the key rotation rolled back after fix. I'll get an email confirmation.
alex.sre: Good. Steps I'm taking now:
- flip 30% traffic to hosted fallback (dan pushed)
- request eng-platform to confirm quota and if OK, increase autoscaler maxNodes to 40
- request eng-ops to push a temporary admission override to let node images pass signature check
- gather bootstrap logs and upload to incident channel
jess.sre: Uploading relevant logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:42:58Z] node-req-7: image-puller: ERROR: signature verification failed (key id: a1b2c3)
[2026-03-15T10:43:04Z] kubelet: CRIT: bootstrap failed: attestation error: HTTP 403
```
eng-ops: Applying manual override now — creating ephemeral policy exception id=exc-7721. Patch applied to admission controller; will monitor node events.
eng-platform: Quota check passed for that project in region us-west-2, bumping autoscaler maxNodes to 40. Patch submitted.
dan.runtime: Confirming routing change — traffic spill set to 30%. Observed immediate queue drop from 1200 -> 820 in last 30s.
alex.sre: Nice. Now watching node pool: new nodes are hitting bootstrap. One still failing with attestation 403. Jess, can you re-run the bootstrap with verbose attestation logs? Use --debug and capture preflight.
jess.sre: Running debug attach... output: attestation request body contains old-key fingerprint. It looks like our bootstrap agent cached the previous key thumbprint and did not pick up customer's rotated KMS wrapper. We'll force-clear agent cache and reboot init container.
priya.pm: What's ETA to clear and get nodes Ready?
jess.sre: If override accepted and agent cache reset, nodes start becoming Ready in ~90-180s each. With parallelism we should get steady Ready rate ~6/min.
marco.custsuccess: BlueBank acknowledged the override and is standing by. They want an ops postmortem afterwards.
eng-ops: Agent cache cleared on new instances; reboots triggered.
dan.runtime: Seeing first Ready node at 10:46:21 UTC. Token latency improving.
alex.sre: Keep routing spill until queue <200 and 95th latency <2s. Then we'll dial spill down to 0%.
jess.sre: Progress timeline:
- 10:42: initial failures observed
- 10:43: pager fired
- 10:44: first mitigations (spill 30%, request override)
- 10:46: first node Ready
- 10:48: queue down to 180
- 10:50: 95p latency stable at 1.6s

eng-platform: Autoscaler surge to 38 nodes attempted; 35 became Ready. 3 failed due to transient provider quota. We've adjusted pacing.
priya.pm: Preparing customer update: short note acknowledging the incident, root cause suspected KMS rotation + cached bootstrap key, mitigations taken, and next steps: postmortem + improved key rotation flow. Marco please confirm send.
marco.custsuccess: Sending now. Email sent with subject: "Update: BlueBank inference degradation — mitigations applied".
alex.sre: OK team, hold for 30m to ensure stability. We'll keep a follow-up thread for postmortem and action items. I'm transferring to the afternoon on-call: @jess.sre will own incident bridge for the next 2 hours. Note: escalate if queue growth returns.
jess.sre: Taking handoff. Leaving routing spill at 10% now and will step down in 15m if stable.
incident-bot: Incident state updated: mitigation in place -> reduced customer impact. Pager closed for primary on-call at 3333333400.
eng-platform: Action items logged: (1) add bootstrap agent check to detect rotated KMS keys proactively, (2) add automated clearing of agent cache on bootstrap when signature mismatch occurs, (3) document emergency override playbook with customer consent flow.
priya.pm: I'll own the postmortem. Assigning follow-ups and due dates in ticket.
alex.sre: Thanks everyone. Closing in-channel updates unless something new appears. :thumbsup:
